rows.rajiv_gandhi_university_rgu_doimukh_arun: Fellowship of ₹1,08,393 per month for up to 1 year, plus contingency grant of ₹1,00,000 per year
Rajiv Gandhi University, Doimukh, Arunachal Pradesh

PhD degree from a recognized University with first class (in terms of grades, etc.) in all preceding levels and a good academic record throughout, completed within the past 5 years on the last date of submission. Candidates with PhD thesis submitted may also apply.
Maximum 40 years (on the date of submission of application)

content_sections.heading: RGU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. AC-4326/Visves./Ph.D Scheme/2024 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download RGU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: PhD degree from a recognized University with first class (in terms of grades, etc.) in all preceding levels and a good academic record throughout; Ph.D. completed within the past 5 years on the last date of submission of application; Candidates with a PhD Thesis submitted may also apply; if selected, must produce the certificate of award of a PhD before joining; Proven academic record, including peer-reviewed publications and recognitions Age limit: Maximum 40 years (on the date of submission of application) Other conditions: Applicant should be an Indian citizen Research proposal should define clear objectives, outcomes and deliverables against the award Researchers in temporary positions must relinquish current roles if selected Mentor/Guide must hold a regular academic/research position in a recognized institution in India with a Ph.D. in Science or Engineering Desirable: Active industry relations Research proposal directed towards industry-specific problems Good number of SCI indexed publications

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for RGU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants currently in regular employment Applicants who completed their Ph.D. at the host institution where the fellowship is to be awarded Applicants who completed Ph.D. more than 5 years before the last date of submission

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Full-time, non-transferable, temporary position tenable in India only Fellowship valid for 1 year (duration up to 1 year)

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Debit Card / Credit Card / Net banking; payment link is in the Google form.

rows.event: Last date of submission of application (11:59 PM, tentative)

content_sections.heading: How Will RGU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening of applications Personal interview Applications will be screened; applicants found suitable will be called for an interview Shortlisted candidates announced through website on 05.12.2026 (tentative) Personal interview and selection list on 10.12.2026 (tentative)

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Proposed research plan (upto 500 words) and Research Proposal Scanned Ph.D. degree certificate, provisional Ph.D. degree awarded certificate, or Ph.D. thesis submitted certificate; Certificate of PhD Scanned Birth certificate, X and XII Marksheets, consolidated UG and PG Grade / Mark Sheets Scanned UG & PG Degree Certificates and Transfer Certificate Details of patents and of 5 best recent publications (first page, DOI) Start-up and technology/product developed details with supporting documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RGU Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online through the Admission portal of Rajiv Gandhi University: https://admissions.rgu.ac.in. Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/- through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net banking; the payment link is in the Google form. Fill up the Google form: https://forms.gle/m7gWnDuvLy1HSAbe7. Enclose the research plan, certificates, mark sheets, publication and patent details listed in the notice. Submit by 02.12.2026, 11:59 PM (tentative last date of submission).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for RGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for RGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Per candidate: Rs. 500 (non-refundable).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years (on the date of submission of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fellowship of ₹1,08,393 per month for up to 1 year, plus contingency grant of ₹1,00,000 per year.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PhD degree from a recognized University with first class (in terms of grades, etc.) in all preceding levels and a good academic record throughout, completed within the past 5 years on the last date of submission. Candidates with PhD thesis submitted may also apply.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant should be an Indian citizen. Research proposal should define clear objectives, outcomes and deliverables against the award. Researchers in temporary positions must relinquish current roles if selected. Mentor/Guide must hold a regular academic/research position in a recognized institution in India with a Ph.D. in Science or Engineering.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants currently in regular employment. Applicants who completed their Ph.D. at the host institution where the fellowship is to be awarded. Applicants who completed Ph.D. more than 5 years before the last date of submission.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening of applications. Personal interview. Applications will be screened; applicants found suitable will be called for an interview. Shortlisted candidates announced through website on 05.12.2026 (tentative).

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Full-time, non-transferable, temporary position tenable in India only. Fellowship valid for 1 year (duration up to 1 year).
